# auto_go_route

> Type-safe, code-generated routing for Flutter on top of go_router. Annotate
> widgets with @AutoGoRoute; a build_runner generator writes the GoRouter
> configuration, typed URL builders and typed BuildContext navigation helpers.

This file is a compact, authoritative brief for AI coding assistants. When it
disagrees with older blog posts or 1.x examples, this file wins.

- Version: 2.0.x
- Requires: Flutter >=3.38.1, Dart >=3.10.0, go_router >=17.5.0 <19.0.0
- Docs: https://pub.dev/packages/auto_go_route
- Source & example app: https://github.com/itsarvinddev/auto_go_route
- Migration from 1.x: https://github.com/itsarvinddev/auto_go_route/blob/main/MIGRATION.md

## Install

```yaml
dependencies:
  auto_go_route: ^2.0.0      # re-exports go_router — do NOT add go_router separately
dev_dependencies:
  auto_go_route_generator: ^2.0.0
  build_runner: ^2.16.1
```

Generate with `dart run build_runner build` (or `watch`). The flag
`--delete-conflicting-outputs` is obsolete in build_runner 2.16+; do not add it.

## Rules an assistant must follow

1. Declare routes by annotating the screen widget. Never hand-write `GoRoute(...)`
   for an annotated screen, and never edit a `*.routes.g.dart` file.
2. Exactly one router library per app (per `sourceGlobs` scope):
   `part '<file>.routes.g.dart';` + `@AutoGoRouteBase(...) class X extends _$X {}`.
3. The router library must import every annotated widget, every type used by
   their constructor parameters, and every function/key named in an annotation
   string. `package:auto_go_route/auto_go_route.dart` covers Flutter/go_router
   types used by generated code.
4. Annotation references are STRINGS naming top-level/static identifiers:
   `middleware: ['requireAuth']`, `errorWidget: 'ErrorScreen.new'`,
   `parentNavigatorKey: 'rootNavigatorKey'`.
5. Build the router once, outside `build()`: `final router = AppRouter().buildRouter(...)`.
   Pass runtime objects (refreshListenable, observers) as `buildRouter` arguments.
6. Navigate with the generated helpers (`context.goToX(...)`), not string paths.
7. After changing annotations or constructor parameters, rerun build_runner.

## Minimal setup

```dart
// lib/pages/product_page.dart
import 'package:auto_go_route/auto_go_route.dart';
import 'package:flutter/material.dart';

@AutoGoRoute(path: '/products/:id', description: 'Product details')
class ProductPage extends StatelessWidget {
  const ProductPage({super.key, required this.id, this.tab});
  final int id;        // path parameter (name appears in the path), decoded as int
  final String? tab;   // query parameter (?tab=...)
  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) => Text('Product $id');
}

// lib/app_router.dart
import 'package:auto_go_route/auto_go_route.dart';
import 'pages/product_page.dart';
part 'app_router.routes.g.dart';

@AutoGoRouteBase(initialLocation: '/products/1')
class AppRouter extends _$AppRouter {}

// lib/main.dart
final router = AppRouter().buildRouter();
void main() => runApp(MaterialApp.router(routerConfig: router));
```

## Parameter classification (per constructor parameter, in order)

1. `key` and a shell's child slot are skipped.
2. Explicit markers win: `@PathParam(['wireName'])`, `@QueryParam(['wireName'])`,
   `@RouteExtra()`, `@RouteIgnore()` (on the field or the parameter).
3. Name appears in the resolved path → path parameter.
4. Type is URL-representable → query parameter.
5. Otherwise → `state.extra` (max ONE per route; make it nullable — extra is lost
   on deep links, reloads and restoration).

URL-representable types: String, int, double, num, bool, BigInt, DateTime, Uri,
any enum (nullable or not); `List<T>` of those as repeated query keys only.

Build errors to avoid:
- `:id?` optional path segments do not exist → use a nullable query param or two routes.
- A required non-nullable query param with no default.
- Constructor params named `queries`, `fragment` or `extra` (rename; keep the
  wire name with `@QueryParam('queries')`).
- Route `name:` must be a valid Dart identifier, unique after capitalisation.

## Generated API (for a widget `ProductPage` with route name `productPage`)

```dart
context.goToProductPage(id: 42, tab: 'reviews');            // go
context.pushToProductPage<bool>(id: 42);                     // push, Future<bool?>
context.replaceWithProductPage(id: 42);                      // pushReplacement
context.replaceInPlaceWithProductPage(id: 42);               // replace
context.locationOfProductPage(id: 42);                       // '/products/42' (no navigation)
// every helper also takes: Map<String, dynamic>? queries, String? fragment, extra

ProductPageRoute.routeName;       // 'productPage'
ProductPageRoute.routeTemplate;   // '/products/:id'
appRouter.productPageRoute.pathWith(id: 42);

appRouter.routes;                 // List<RouteBase>
appRouter.buildRouter({...every GoRouter option, defaulting to the annotation});
appRouter.buildRoutingConfig();   // RoutingConfig for dynamic routing
appRouter.buildDynamicRouter(routingConfig: valueNotifier);
AppRoute.values;                  // enum of all routes (name + template)
DashboardShellBranch.values;      // enum per stateful shell, in tab order
```

The generated class is `<WidgetClass>Route` and the helper suffix is the route
name capitalised. Default route name = widget class name in lowerCamelCase.

## Nesting

```dart
@AutoGoRoute(path: 'reviews', parent: ProductPage)   // relative path
class ReviewsPage extends StatelessWidget {
  const ReviewsPage({super.key, required this.id});  // inherits :id
  final int id;
}
// → /products/:id/reviews ; context.goToReviewsPage(id: 42)
```

## Shells

Stateless shell (shared chrome around children):
```dart
@AutoGoRouteShell(path: '/settings-area', initialRoute: '/general')
class SettingsShell extends StatelessWidget {
  const SettingsShell({super.key, required this.child});
  final Widget child;
  ...
}
@AutoGoRoute(path: '/general', parent: SettingsShell)
class GeneralPage extends StatelessWidget { ... }
```

Stateful shell (bottom navigation, preserved tab state):
```dart
@AutoGoRouteShell(path: '/', isStateful: true)
class DashboardShell extends StatelessWidget {
  const DashboardShell({super.key, required this.navigationShell});
  final StatefulNavigationShell navigationShell;
  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) => Scaffold(
    body: navigationShell,
    bottomNavigationBar: NavigationBar(
      selectedIndex: navigationShell.currentIndex,
      onDestinationSelected: (i) {
        final branch = DashboardShellBranch.values[i];
        branch.go(navigationShell, initialLocation: branch.isActiveIn(navigationShell));
      },
      destinations: const [...],
    ),
  );
}

@AutoGoRoute(path: '/feed', parent: DashboardShell, order: 0)
@AutoGoRouteBranch(preload: true)
class FeedPage extends StatelessWidget { ... }
```

Shell facts:
- Shells contribute no URL segment: `/feed` above is at `/feed`.
- A root shell at `/` gets an automatic redirect from `/` to its first branch.
- A shell's own path redirects to `initialRoute` (default: first parameter-free child).
- Stateful shells: put `navigatorKey`/`observers`/`preload`/`initialLocation` on
  `@AutoGoRouteBranch` on the child; a branch whose first route has path
  parameters needs `@AutoGoRouteBranch(initialLocation: '...')`.
- Switch tabs from inside a branch: `DashboardShellBranch.settings.goFrom(context)`.

## Guards and redirects

```dart
// Route-level guard (in the router library)
FutureOr<String?> requireAuth(BuildContext context, GoRouterState state) =>
    authService.isLoggedIn ? null : '/login';

@AutoGoRoute(path: '/profile', middleware: ['requireAuth'])
class ProfilePage extends StatelessWidget { ... }

// Recommended: one top-level guard reading route metadata
@AutoGoRoute(path: '/admin', metadata: {'requiresRole': 'admin'})
class AdminPage extends StatelessWidget { ... }

FutureOr<String?> appRedirect(BuildContext context, GoRouterState state) {
  final role = state.metadataAs<String>('requiresRole');
  return role != null && authService.role != role ? '/home' : null;
}

@AutoGoRouteBase(redirect: 'appRedirect')
class AppRouter extends _$AppRouter {}

final router = AppRouter().buildRouter(refreshListenable: authService);
```

Order: route `redirect:` runs before `middleware:`; first non-null wins.
`onExit: 'confirmLeave'` (FutureOr<bool> Function(BuildContext, GoRouterState))
asks before a route is popped. `onEnter:` on @AutoGoRouteBase runs before every
navigation (return `Allow()` / `Block.stop()`).

## Pages and transitions

```dart
@AutoGoRoute(
  path: '/compose',
  transition: AutoRouteTransition.slideUp,   // platform, material, cupertino, fade,
  transitionDurationMs: 250,                 // slide, slideUp, slideDown, scale, rotation, none
  fullscreenDialog: true,
  parentNavigatorKey: 'rootNavigatorKey',    // draw over a shell
)
```
For a key named in `parentNavigatorKey`, also set
`@AutoGoRouteBase(navigatorKey: 'rootNavigatorKey')`.
Custom page: `pageBuilder: 'myPageBuilder'` (not together with `transition:`).
Bottom sheet / dialog with a real URL: shell `pageBuilder` returning
`AdaptiveOverlayPage(child: child)`.

## @AutoGoRouteBase options

navigatorKey, initialLocation, initialExtra, errorWidget | errorBuilder |
errorPageBuilder | onException (at most ONE), redirect, onEnter, observers,
refreshListenable, extraCodec, redirectLimit, routerNeglect, debugLogDiagnostics,
overridePlatformDefaultLocation, requestFocus, restorationScopeId, caseSensitive
(default for routes), navigatorExtensionName, generateRouteEnum, sourceGlobs.

## Reading parameters by hand (guards, onExit, tests)

```dart
RouteCodec.requireInt(state, 'id');
RouteCodec.optionalEnum(state, 'sort', Sort.values);
state.getParam<int?>('page');
state.getOptionalParam<int>('page', 1);
state.metadataAs<bool>('requiresAuth');
state.extraAs<Product>();
```
Malformed values throw `RouteParamFormatException`.

## Troubleshooting

- `Undefined name` / build error listing missing names → import them into the router library.
- Build hangs or `visitDotShorthandPropertyAccess` → you are on 1.x; upgrade to 2.0.
- `ambiguous_extension_member_access` on `pushNamed` → 1.x; upgrade.
- Route missing → routes outside `lib/` are not scanned by default (use `sourceGlobs`).
- Two routers in one package → give each `@AutoGoRouteBase(sourceGlobs: [...])`.
